info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - IP — Access Lists
info.description: IP access control lists (standard, extended, named), prefix-lists, community-lists.

get.description:
Retrieve access-list configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace access-list configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update access-list configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove access-list configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
